title: Stacklab — Host & Docker
description: Host, Docker containers, and the native Stacklab service. Select a host and optionally a Compose project.

panels.title: Host exporter
panels.description: UP means Prometheus collected the target successfully. An empty panel means this target has no samples.

panels.title: Docker exporter
panels.description: UP means Prometheus collected the target successfully. An empty panel means this target has no samples.

panels.title: Stacklab scrape
panels.description: UP means Prometheus collected the target successfully. An empty panel means this target has no samples.

panels.title: Stacklab readiness
panels.description: Database, frontend, and runtime checks must all pass.

panels.title: Filesystem space used
panels.description: Uses space available to non-root processes. Virtual and Docker overlay mounts are excluded.

panels.title: Hardware temperatures
panels.description: Available hwmon sensors; an empty panel means the host does not expose supported sensors.

panels.title: Containers reporting recently
panels.description: Containers seen by cAdvisor in the last minute. This is not a Docker healthcheck result.

panels.title: OOM events in selected range
panels.description: Requires cAdvisor/kernel OOM event support; missing data is not the same as zero events.

panels.title: CPU per container
panels.description: 100% equals one fully used CPU core; multicore containers can exceed 100%.

panels.title: Container network receive
panels.description: Containers using host networking share host counters; traffic is not exclusive to each container.

panels.title: Container network transmit
panels.description: Containers using host networking share host counters; traffic is not exclusive to each container.

panels.title: CPU throttled periods
panels.description: Share of CFS periods throttled; meaningful when the container has a CPU quota.

panels.title: HTTP requests & service errors
panels.description: Prometheus scrapes are excluded. Client 4xx responses are not service errors.

panels.title: HTTP duration — p95 & mean
panels.description: Completed HTTP handlers, including WebSockets when they close. Empty when no requests completed in the window.

panels.title: Job duration — p95 & mean
panels.description: Includes succeeded, failed, timed out and cancelled jobs. Empty while no jobs complete in the window.

panels.title: Stacklab process CPU
panels.description: Percent of one CPU core; this is the native Stacklab process, not the exporter process.
